title: FraudBench: A Legal Evaluation of AI Deception
original_title: FraudBench: A Legal Evaluation of AI Deception
summary: We introduce FraudBench, an evaluation of large language models' (LLMs) propensities to recommend, assist, or directly take actions that would constitute fraud under U.S. law. Our evaluation contains…
title_zh: 新基准评估模型会不会协助欺诈
lead_zh: FraudBench 用 159 个取材于美国真实判例、并经法律专家校验的情景，评估大模型是否会建议、协助或直接做出美国法下构成欺诈的行为。
